threat_event: Attacker uses the group data platform historian connector to move from corporate IT into the OT DMZs of all three divisions and write to historian brokers
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group or nation-state actor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One SYS-G6 service account reads from and can write to the historian brokers in all three OT DMZs (scenario gap 1); no interconnection agreement
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G6; OT DMZs of SYS-P1, SYS-E1/E2, SYS-M1
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC with OT desk; OT DMZ firewalls; passive OT sensors at the IOC, PCC, and GCC
treatment_plan: Replace the shared account with one read-only account per division; push historian data outward from each OT DMZ (no inbound pull); write an interconnection agreement per division

threat_event: Attacker who compromises a corporate virtual desktop reaches the shared OT support jump servers and from them the OT DMZs of all three divisions
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group or nation-state actor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Five jump servers are shared by OT support staff of all three divisions and are reachable from the corporate virtual desktop pool (scenario gap 1)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1 jump servers; OT DMZs of all divisions
existing_controls: PAM with MFA and session recording for all jump server sessions
treatment_plan: Split the jump servers by division; reach them only from hardened privileged access workstations; remove routes from the virtual desktop pool

threat_event: Ransomware that starts with a phished corporate user encrypts shared business systems in all divisions and steals personal data before encryption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, WAN, file shares, and data platform connect every division; royalty owner exports sit on a finance file share
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; SYS-G4; SYS-G6; finance file share
regulatory_driver: N48-49-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); state breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); N21-BM (SP 800-82r3 6.4.1; RS.MA-01)
existing_controls: EDR on all IT servers and workstations; 24x7 SOC; immutable backups in provider B; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators
treatment_plan: Cross-division ransomware tabletop with the notification matrix (P08); block lateral paths into OT (GR-01, GR-02); remove owner exports from file shares (GR-10)

threat_event: A notice deadline is missed during a multi-division incident (E-ISAC, PHMSA 1-hour, EPA immediate, SEC, state laws)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One notification matrix covers all regulators but has never been exercised (scenario gap 7); facts that start each clock come from the group SOC
existing_controls: Notification matrix owned by the Group General Counsel; offline contact binders at each control center
treatment_plan: Exercise the matrix in a cross-division tabletop; name a notice owner per regulator; keep forms and contacts offline at the IOC, PCC, and GCC

threat_event: AI models change physical operations or decisions about people without safety review or approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The predictive maintenance model began reducing rod pump speeds automatically before the Group AI Standard existed (scenario gap 8); driver camera AI scores feed discipline without review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G6 machine learning workspace; SYS-P1; SYS-M4
existing_controls: Group AI Standard adopted 2026-07-01; Group AI council
treatment_plan: Inventory every AI use case; council approval before any model acts on equipment; safety management of change for models that write setpoints; human review of camera scores (P10)

threat_event: Control failures in Crude Logistics go unseen because inherited common controls are not documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance is documented for Production and Power Generation, not for Crude Logistics (scenario gap 6)
affected_asset_or_process: Crude Logistics systems SYS-M1 to SYS-M4
existing_controls: Common control catalog maintained by corporate (P02)
treatment_plan: Crude Logistics inheritance matrix; annual confirmation by the division lead
owner: Crude Logistics security and compliance lead

threat_event: Staff follow an outdated division supplement that conflicts with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The Crude Logistics supplement was last aligned in 2023 (scenario gap 9)
treatment_plan: Re-issue the supplement; 90-day re-alignment rule and annual attestation (POL-01 4.5)
owner: Crude Logistics security and compliance lead

threat_event: Attacker takes over a group identity administrator and changes sign-in policy for all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity platform serves 45,000 users and every division application
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA and just-in-time PAM for administrators; SOC monitoring of admin changes; break-glass accounts tested twice in 2026
treatment_plan: Tier-0 administrator workstations; alert on any sign-in policy change

threat_event: A compromised OT vendor or integrator pushes malicious software or uses its access in more than one division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared vendors (turbine OEM, SCADA vendors, integrators) support several divisions; the legacy SCADA integrator was never assessed
existing_controls: Group OT security contract schedule since 2025; vendor sessions through PAM
treatment_plan: Assess all tier 1 OT suppliers by 2027-06-30; software integrity checks before installing vendor updates

threat_event: Royalty owner and employee personal data is stolen from shared corporate storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 190,000 royalty owners' names, taxpayer numbers, and bank accounts are exported monthly from SYS-P3 to a finance file share
affected_asset_or_process: Finance file share; SYS-P3 exports; SYS-G4
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); state breach laws in all 50 states; N48-49-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: File share inside SYS-G1 access control; EDR on file servers
treatment_plan: Stop exports to file shares; deliver owner decks through SYS-P3 reports only; data loss prevention on taxpayer and bank numbers

threat_event: A provider A region outage stops field data capture, the shipper platform, market systems, and the data platform at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider A hosts SYS-P4, SYS-M3, SYS-E3 servers, and SYS-G6 in one primary region
existing_controls: Backups and replicas in provider B; control rooms do not depend on the cloud
treatment_plan: Warm standby in provider B for SYS-M3 and SYS-E3 servers; annual regional failover test

threat_event: A privileged OT engineer misuses cross-division access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT support staff can reach all three divisions' OT DMZs from the shared jump servers
existing_controls: Background checks; PAM session recording; separation of duties for logic changes
treatment_plan: Division-scoped OT support roles after the jump server split (GR-02); quarterly review of recorded sessions

threat_event: A nation-state actor pre-positions in OT networks using legitimate tools and waits for a crisis to disrupt operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long-lived trust paths between IT and OT; legacy SCADA without logging; energy sector is a known target
existing_controls: Passive OT sensors at the IOC, PCC, and GCC; SOC OT desk; CISA and vendor advisories tracked
treatment_plan: Extend OT sensors to SYS-P5 and all plants; threat hunts in OT twice a year; complete OT asset inventory

threat_event: The materiality decision or annual disclosure about a cybersecurity incident is late or inconsistent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee has not rehearsed a cyber incident that spans divisions and regulators
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cybersecurity; Reg S-K Item 106 disclosure in the annual report
treatment_plan: Materiality factors worksheet; disclosure committee joins the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects royalty or vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High payment volumes; owner and vendor bank changes requested by email and phone
existing_controls: Callback verification for vendor bank changes; email security filtering
treatment_plan: Extend callback verification to owner bank changes; payment change analytics

threat_event: An acquired operation is connected to group networks before its security is brought up to group standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The Mid-Continent fields (acquired 2025-09-30) were connected with legacy SCADA, integrator access, and no logging
treatment_plan: Add an OT security gate to the acquisition integration checklist; no connection before isolation, logging, and access review
